title: Transformers: Peter Cullen’s Final Optimus Prime Performance Is Streaming Today
summary: Peter Cullen's passing was an incredible loss for the Transformers community The post Transformers: Peter Cullen’s Final Optimus Prime Performance Is Streaming Today appeared first on ComingSoon.net - Movie Trailers, TV & Streaming News, and More .
content: Photo Credit - Hasbro Entertainment Peter Cullen ‘s passing was an incredible loss for the Transformers community. The late voice actor portrayed Optimus Prime across multiple Transformers projects, and fans will have an opportunity to hear him play the character one final time. As part of the 40th anniversary of 1986’s The Transformers: The Movie, Hasbro released a new 12-minute animated short. Optimus Prime: Awakening features Peter Cullen as the leader of the Autobots for the final time. As reported by CBR , the short can be streamed for free through a YouTube Premiere Limited-Time Event on Friday at 8:00 p.m. ET. Fans will also have an opportunity to see The Transformers: The Movie online as part of the Limited-Time Event. They will also be able to join a waiting room on the Transformers fan channel before the movie starts and chat during the stream. The online event follows the September re-release of the movie, which grossed over $6 million. The Transformers 40th-anniversary celebration brings back a beloved classic The Transformers: The Movie was a significant cultural milestone in the franchise’s history. Often considered one of the best pieces of Transformers media, the film is credited with ushering in a new era for both longtime fans and new viewers in 1986. Transformers and other science fiction and fantasy franchises have become mainstream lately. Although some contemporary reviews viewed the 1986 film primarily as children’s entertainment, its reputation has evolved and turned more positive. Modern perspectives on the movie praise the dark tone, especially its decision to kill Optimus Prime . The movie has also been called a milestone in animation history, given the subject matter that it portrayed on screen. Its multiple character deaths and unsettling imagery challenged expectations of what animated films aimed at younger audiences could portray. Optimus Prime: Awakening is a fully realized, 12-minute animated short created as a tribute to the Transformers community. Originally reported on SuperHeroHype .
